map.侧光/耳光取 30–60°，用高度与水平距离算俯角与斜射距离，避免演员面部阴影过: Side light uses 30–60°; compute the depression angle and slant distance from height and horizontal distance to avoid heavy shadows on the performer's face.

map.算例：高 6m、距 5m 的面光: Worked example: front light at 6 m height, 5 m distance
map.灯具高度 6m、水平距离 5m：投射角 = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2: Fixture height 6 m, horizontal distance 5 m: throw angle = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2°, depression angle ≈ 39.8°, slant distance ≈ 7.81 m, height/distance ratio 1.20, i.e. front light (40–50°). Then with a throw angle of 45°, height 6 m and beam angle 25°: horizontal mounting distance = 6 / tan45° = 6.00 m, slant distance ≈ 8.49 m, spot radius ≈ 1.88 m, diameter ≈ 3.76 m, illuminated area ≈ 11.12 m².
map.投射角越大越好吗？: Is a larger throw angle always better?
map.不是。角度过大趋近顶光/逆光，会减少面部亮度、加重阴影；面光以 40–50° 为: No. Too large an angle approaches top or back light, reducing facial brightness and deepening shadows; front light works best at 40–50° and side light at 45–60°, combined according to the shaping goal.
map.高度和距离哪个对光斑大小影响更大？: Which affects spot size more, height or distance?
map.在固定光束角下，光斑直径 ≈ 2 × 斜射距离 × tan(半角)，斜射距离随高: At a fixed beam angle, spot diameter ≈ 2 × slant distance × tan(half angle); slant distance grows with both height and distance, so together they determine the coverage area.
